output_list.criticism: The mint function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the total supply of the token to a target address, causing a buy function to be unusable.
The buyTokens function has an integer overflow that allows attackers to make the total supply of the token exceed the TOKEN_LIMIT, causing a buy function to be unusable.
The buyTokens function has a wrong logic that allows attackers to buy tokens at a price of 0.
